verses.12:94: وَلَمَّا فَصَلَتِ ٱلۡعِيرُ قَالَ أَبُوهُمۡ إِنِّي لَأَجِدُ رِيحَ يُوسُفَۖ لَوۡلَآ أَن تُفَنِّدُونِ

meaning: The Quranic verb تُفَنِّدُونِ in 12:94 concerns attributing foolishness, senility, or unsound judgment to someone. Classical senses involving a large mountain are not the relevant Quranic sense here.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
meaning_source_d2: The root فند (fnd) primarily refers to a large, prominent mountain or a distinct part of it, like a peak. It can also describe a group of people, often scattered or in separate companies.
